contact.002.en: Email bazifor.me with a question, a correction, a data-deletion request or a bug. Replies are best effort, with no promised time.
contact.002.zh: 有问题、要更正、要删除数据或发现故障，请发邮件给 bazifor.me。我们尽力回复，不承诺回复时间。

contact.014.en: Questions, corrections, deletion requests and bugs
contact.014.zh: 提问、更正、删除请求和故障反馈

contact.019.en: a question about a reading or how the site works
contact.019.zh: 对解读或本站运作方式的疑问

contact.020.en: a correction to a rule, a date or a translation
contact.020.zh: 对某条规则、某个日期或某处翻译的更正

contact.021.en: a request to delete your data

contact.022.en: a bug (tell us the page and what you did)
contact.022.zh: 发现故障（请告诉我们是哪个页面、你做了什么）

contact.023.en: For a deletion request, include your workspace link so we know which workspace you mean. You can also delete it yourself, in one step, from the workspace page.
contact.023.zh: 提出删除请求时，请附上你的工作区链接，让我们知道你指的是哪个工作区。你也可以在工作区页面一步删除。

contact.024.zh: 删除是怎么回事：隐私说明

contact.026.en: We answer as we can. We do not promise a reply time.
contact.026.zh: 我们尽力回复，但不承诺回复时间。

contact.027.en: Email is the only way to reach us.
contact.027.zh: 联系我们只有发邮件这一种方式。

contact.028.zh: © bazifor.me，按固定规则推算的八字与风水解读。
